changes_from_original: Replace the universal printed valuation by a family of exact locally verified residue-matrix results.
retained_open_obligations: Finish the actual β(4) pencil and its Lagrange identity.

historical_evidence: Existing main/companion receipts remain attached to their exact declarations and scope. No fresh certification here.
